text: Pares, areli, tu ches, eki. Aes, atam. Biran, et pagi. Vor pagi, em, vonc, ek buze. Chikidam, chere, zakanj, incha, ilara, sirumes, inz, ghesi, imot, gani, bashamem, kenganiteses. Atam, net, kane, anka, mes, levanum. Erku. Asma, erku. Gendak, kukurus, tati, karezi, beran, chesi, hayat, akhpe. Lezvit, vera, pulpulak, tenen, kaifot, lerven, kmeramash. Kalini, zer, vot, kash, ek, den, chis, varit. Che, chilni. Karas, hetes flirt chanes. Lichis flirt che mare. Vayinches ackov talis. Jure pazatsreti kackis. Zainak kdri. Tele, gitais incha. Tele of torusik kagitam incha. Abres, hes tele of torusik ove atamnerit arank ke makrem. Vazgen papi, miatka hambe saarevas. Izna, isents. Karvan gitais horet da chenara, inches ents avelanum. Vayat samakas, halva es utum sagora, jure, jure te sa chka beran. Pechenik ute. Porcvele tenz banerut e shlucha. Esko atamna shatna. Yev, normala sa. Jes kiankom tenz ban shaitese. Istvor te sa, uzumei bzushkutun e toheli nakhul. Zgume, shin shvomi ban inchi, shvomi ati imastutian atam e chka, chishta, voite votit mecha. Uhi at sartit vara piercing, kada. Vursafumam saavum, a? Che. Jesu koker ni ke idalet khanelink. Ij. Sabat? Ja. Sto, eis meka hanumi.
